mcqs.question: Who presented the Padma Awards 2026 at Civil Investiture Ceremony-I held at Rashtrapati Bhavan?
mcqs.explanation: The Padma Awards 2026 were presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Civil Investiture Ceremony-I at Rashtrapati Bhavan. K T Thomas, N Rajam and V S Achuthanandan were among the awardees, not the presenter.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Padma Awards 2026 is incorrect?
options: A total of 131 awards comprised 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri awards.
A duo was counted as one awardee.
The awards included 16 women, 6 foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI and 19 posthumous awardees.
The awards were presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Civil Investiture Ceremony-I at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the awards included 16 women and 19 posthumous awardees. The correct figures were 19 women and 16 posthumous awardees; the figures for foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI and the other statements are correct.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Padma Awards 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The awards were presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
2. The total of 131 awards included 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri awards.
3. A duo was counted as two awards.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: President Droupadi Murmu presented the awards at Rashtrapati Bhavan, and the total was 131 with the stated category-wise composition. Statement 3 is incorrect because a duo was counted as one award.

mcqs.question: Who succeeded Gen Anil Chauhan as the Chief of Defence Staff in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Lt Gen N.S. Raja Subramani (Retd.) succeeded Gen Anil Chauhan as the Chief of Defence Staff. Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan was appointed as the next Chief of Naval Staff, while Rajesh Kumar Singh received additional charge of DRDO Chairman.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the defence and security appointments of May 2026 is incorrect?
options: Anurag Garg’s tenure as NCB Director-General was extended till 31 July 2026.
Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan was appointed as the next Chief of Naval Staff from 31 May 2026.
Rajesh Kumar Singh received additional charge as DRDO Chairman after Dr. Samir V. Kamat’s retirement.
Praveen Sood received a one-year extension as CBI Director.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes the extended tenure of Anurag Garg. His tenure as NCB Director-General was extended till 31 July 2027, not 31 July 2026; the other three statements correctly describe the appointments.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Kota Ravi was appointed the 22nd Chairman and Managing Director of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.
Statement B: The headquarters of the Marine Products Export Development Authority is located in Visakhapatnam.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct because Kota Ravi became the 22nd CMD of HAL. Statement B is incorrect because MPEDA’s headquarters is in Kochi, while Visakhapatnam has its regional office.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed Permanent Chairman and Managing Director of Visakhapatnam Steel Plant on 8 May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: MNVS Prabhakar was appointed Permanent CMD of Visakhapatnam Steel Plant on 8 May 2026. Ashok Kumar Panda was appointed CMD of SAIL, Anugraha Narayan Das became CGDA, and Justice Anupinder Singh Grewal became President of NCLT.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit in Oslo on 18 May 2026.
Reason (R): He was presented Sweden’s Royal Order of the Polar Star—Commander Grand Cross by Crown Princess Victoria.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the Norwegian honour was conferred in Oslo on 18 May 2026, and the Swedish honour was presented by Crown Princess Victoria. The Swedish honour does not explain the separate Norwegian honour, so the second option is correct.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Prime Minister Narendra Modi receiving the FAO Agricola Medal, consider the following statements:
1. The medal was presented at FAO headquarters in Rome on 20 May 2026.
2. It was presented by FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu.
3. The FAO Agricola Medal is among FAO’s highest honours.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The FAO Agricola Medal was presented at FAO headquarters in Rome on 20 May 2026 by Director-General Qu Dongyu, and it is among FAO’s highest honours.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Kuljeet Kaur Marhas being honoured by The Meteoritical Society, consider the following statements:
1. She became the first Indian woman to be elected a Fellow of The Meteoritical Society.
2. She became only the third Indian in the Society's 95-year history.
3. She is the second Indian woman to receive the honour.
options: None of the statements is correct
mcqs.explanation: Exactly one statement is correct: Kuljeet Kaur Marhas became the first Indian woman and only the third Indian in The Meteoritical Society's 93-year history. The second statement is incorrect because the Society's history was 93 years, not 95 years; the third is incorrect because she was the first Indian woman, not the second.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Justice Lavu Nageswara Rao became the second Indian to be appointed an Honorary Bencher of the Inner Temple, London.
Statement B: Justice Lavu Nageswara Rao became the first Indian to receive this honour.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true, while Statement B is false. Justice Lavu Nageswara Rao was the second Indian to receive the honour, after Justice Prateek Jalan in 2023; therefore, he was not the first Indian.

mcqs.question: Which State received the highest number of awards in the National Panchayat Awards 2025 selection?
options: All participating States and Union Territories received the same number
mcqs.explanation: Karnataka received the highest number of awards, with six. Andhra Pradesh and Odisha received five awards each, so neither matched Karnataka's total.

mcqs.question: The Goddard Astronautics Award received for Chandrayaan-3 was conferred by which organisation?
options: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics
mcqs.explanation: The award was conferred by the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics, or AIAA, and was received for ISRO by Ambassador Vinay Kwatra. The Royal Society, Society of Experimental Test Pilots and Inner Temple are associated with other honours in the news.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): “Taiwan Travelogue” by Yang Shuang-zi, translated by Lin King, won the International Booker Prize 2026.
Reason (R): The prize was launched in 2005 as the Man Booker International Prize.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true. However, the 2005 launch of the prize as the Man Booker International Prize does not explain why “Taiwan Travelogue” won the 2026 award.

mcqs.question: In which Pulitzer Prize 2026 category did Anand RK, Suparna Sharma and Natalie Obiko Pearson win for the investigation titled “trAPPed”?
mcqs.explanation: The three journalists won in the Illustrated Reporting and Commentary category for “trAPPed”, published by Bloomberg. The investigation exposed digital arrest scams in India, while the other options are unrelated awards or award programmes.

mcqs.question: Who received the 2025 UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award?
mcqs.explanation: Major Abhilasha Barak received the 2025 UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award. Major Suman Gawani and Major Radhika Sen were earlier Indian recipients, while Lance Havildar Harbhajan Singh received the posthumous Dag Hammarskjöld Medal.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly matches an Indian conservationist with the species associated with the Whitley Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Barkha Subba won the Whitley Award for work associated with the Himalayan Salamander. Parveen Shaikh was associated with the endangered Indian Skimmer, making the second pairing the most tempting but incorrect alternative.

mcqs.question: Who received the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize 2026 for documenting attacks on journalists in the Sudan conflict?
mcqs.explanation: The Sudanese Journalists Syndicate received the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize 2026 for documenting attacks on journalists in the Sudan conflict. UNESCO is associated with the prize, but it was not the winning organisation.

mcqs.question:
Match the laureates of the UNESCO–L'Oréal For Women in Science International Awards 2026 with their countries.

List-I
 a. Sarah A. Teichmann
 b. Liesl Zühlke
 c. Raquel Chan
 d. Felice Jacka

List-II
 i. Argentina
 ii. Australia
 iii. South Africa
 iv. United Kingdom
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iv, b-iii, c-i and d-ii: Sarah A. Teichmann—United Kingdom, Liesl Zühlke—South Africa, Raquel Chan—Argentina and Felice Jacka—Australia. The closest trap reverses several country associations.

mcqs.question: Who won the Palme d'Or at the 79th Cannes Film Festival 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Palme d'Or went to "Ford", directed by Cristian Mungiu. "Minotaur" won the Grand Prix, while "The Dreamed Adventure" won the Jury Prize and "Beniman" won the Caméra d'Or.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the winners at the 79th Cannes Film Festival 2026 is incorrect?
options: "Ford" won the Palme d'Or for Cristian Mungiu.
"Fatherland" won the Best Director award for Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo.
"The Dreamed Adventure" won the Jury Prize.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the third one. Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo jointly won Best Director for "The Black Ball", whereas Paweł Pawlikowski won it for "Fatherland".

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The one-film-per-country restriction for the International Feature category was removed for the 99th Academy Awards.
Statement B: The Best International Feature award will go to the director rather than the country.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true under the rules for the 99th Academy Awards. The International Feature restriction was removed, and the award will now go to the director instead of the country.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Yoweri Museveni was sworn in for a sixth term as Uganda's leader in May 2026.
Reason (R): He has been in power since 1986.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: The Assertion is false because Yoweri Museveni was sworn in for his seventh term, not his sixth. The Reason is true: he has been in power since 1986.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about the world leaders and appointments reported in May 2026 are correct?

1. Janez Janša became Slovenia's Prime Minister for the fourth time.
2. Laura Virginia Fernández Delgado was sworn in as Costa Rica's 50th President.
3. Jeremiah Manele lost a no-confidence vote by 26 votes to 22 in the Solomon Islands' 50-member House.
4. Ali Falih Khadim Al-Zaidi became Iraq's Prime Minister from 15 May 2026.
mcqs.explanation: Exactly three statements are correct: the statements about Janez Janša, Laura Virginia Fernández Delgado and Jeremiah Manele. The fourth statement is incorrect because Ali Falih Khadim Al-Zaidi became Iraq's Prime Minister from 16 May 2026.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed India's next Ambassador to Oman at Muscat?
mcqs.explanation: Prashant Pise, an IFS officer of the 1995 batch, was appointed India's next Ambassador to Oman. Sultan Haitham bin Tarik is identified as Oman's Sultan, while Abdul Latif Rashid is identified as Iraq's President.

mcqs.question: Which person, who died in May 2026, was the first Indian President of the Olympic Council of Asia?
mcqs.explanation: Raja Randhir Singh was the first Indian President of the Olympic Council of Asia. Ted Turner was the founder of CNN, while Bashir Badr was an eminent Urdu poet.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: “The Bench, the Bar, and the Bizarre” and “The Lawful and the Awful” were released by C.P. Radhakrishnan in New Delhi on 10 May 2026.
Statement B: “Apnapan” was authored by Shivraj Singh Chouhan and released on 26 May 2026.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because the two books by Tushar Mehta were released by Amit Shah in New Delhi on 10 May 2026. Statement B is true: “Apnapan” was authored by Shivraj Singh Chouhan and released on 26 May 2026.

mcqs.question: Who released the book “The Constitution is My Home”?
mcqs.explanation: “The Constitution is My Home”, authored by Indira Jaising and Ritu Menon, was released by Supreme Court Justices Surya Kant and B.V. Nagarathna. C.P. Radhakrishnan released the book on P.N. Panicker, while P.T. Usha and Dilip Tirkey released the book on India’s Olympic hockey triumph.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Udant Martand was India’s first Hindi newspaper.
Reason (R): IIMC released a special edition of “Sanchar Madhyam” on 5 June 2026.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true: Udant Martand was India’s first Hindi newspaper. Reason R is false because IIMC released the special edition of “Sanchar Madhyam” on 5 May 2026, not 5 June 2026.

mcqs.keyword: First woman IAF Cat-A Qualified Flying Instructor
mcqs.question: What distinction was achieved by Squadron Leader Sanya in the Indian Air Force?
options: She became the first woman IAF officer to establish the Indian Air Force
She became the first woman IAF officer to receive the National Florence Nightingale Award
She became the first woman IAF officer to be recognised by DASCA
She became the first woman IAF officer to qualify as a Cat-A Qualified Flying Instructor
mcqs.explanation: Squadron Leader Sanya became the first woman IAF officer to qualify as a Cat-A Qualified Flying Instructor. The National Florence Nightingale Awards concern nursing professionals, while DASCA recognition was given to O.P. Jindal Global University.
